farmIncidents.title: Early Stalk Borer Pressure on North Maize Edge
farmIncidents.description: Scouting found pin-hole leaf feeding along the northern windbreak edge of North Contour Maize Block affecting 14,000 of the 420,000 originally planted maize stands.
recommendedActions: Inspect adjacent rows at 7-day intervals for new egg batches.
Consult local KZN extension agronomist before applying targeted control.

followUps.actionTaken: Cleared border weeds and inspected whorl damage across rows 1–12.
followUps.notes: Damage stabilized; no spread beyond initial 0.35 ha zone.

farmIncidents.title: Afternoon Thunderstorm Wind & Light Hail Bruising
farmIncidents.description: Brief convective hail shower bruised outer leaves on 2,100 Swiss Chard plants on Lower Dam Vegetable Terrace.
recommendedActions: Harvest undamaged inner leaves early and divert bruised trimmings to poultry feed.
Check drip lateral emitters for silt clogging after storm runoff.

followUps.actionTaken: Salvaged trimmed leaves for Layer Flock B and flushed drip lines.
